items.summary: Recommendation: queue three reversible SEO improvements on xxxtea.com, marineactivity.com, and fishhooklabs.com, while continuing the existing Great American Lakes measurement and keeping SearchWoot private. Evidence: the 30-day SEO window shows xxxtea.com with 87 impressions split across five pages, marineactivity.com with 239 impressions, 2 clicks, position 8.3, and fishhooklabs.com with 138 impressions, 2 clicks, position 9.3. Portfolio affiliate revenue is $4.92 from 2026-09-21, but site-level revenue, margin, ROI, and experiment impact are not calculable because attribution is incomplete. The main unknown is whether these changes improve qualified clicks or conversions. Smallest next step: enter the three bounded changes into the engineer queue and measure at the existing 14-day or 100-impression gate, with rollback if guardrails regress. Owner question: for SearchWoot, choose A) keep private pending all legal, security, accuracy, and measurement gates (recommended), or B) authorize preparation—but not sending—of a written Woot permission request.
